model_annotation: This bar chart compares the performance of six different language model variants—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across multiple experimental conditions, with each condition represented by a distinct group of bars. The horizontal axis displays these experimental conditions, though the specific labels are not legible in the image. The vertical axis represents performance values, scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals (e.g., 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each group of bars corresponds to one experimental condition and contains six bars, each colored according to the model variant as indicated in the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. The height of each bar indicates the mean performance value for that model under that condition, and the vertical error bars represent the standard deviation or standard error of the mean. The bars are not sorted by height; instead, they are arranged in the order of the experimental conditions along the horizontal axis. All bars are presented with consistent styling, including solid fills and standard error bars, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
